note: Calibration controls of plan B section 4.4. Each control is rendered for pair A (over flat #14161A, base ref_hudonly.png) and pair B (over the mockup world, base ref_backdrop.png) from the same board 3.1a with one thing changed by ref_capture.js. Node ids are the pre-order DOM index = elements[].id of research/hud-ref/board-3.1-elements.json. intended_boxes are [x0,y0,x1,y1) in board pixels, taken from those elements' boxes plus a 2 px margin (N1: the union of every card element, plus the 1 px shift); regions are the names of section 4.2 (T1's regions.json). Positives must PASS every gate in T2; each negative must FAIL, only in its listed regions.

P1.change: the 10 static OFL TTFs (hud-ref/fonts, the files Unreal will load) served instead of Google's variable woff2

P2.dropped_reason: T0 measured that font-kerning:none moves the unit name's right ink edge by 2 px, beyond G5's 1 px. Slate is configured to kern (FullShaping, F7), so kerning-off is not a state the build can produce, and a positive control must model an allowed rendering difference. Dropped by the main-session decision of EXECUTION section 7 (B, T2); gates unchanged. No P2 file is rendered.

P3.change: every text-bearing element and every svg offset by .4 px right and .3 px down, each exactly once (an element inside an already-offset element is skipped: it moves with its ancestor) (relative position for static boxes, the translate property otherwise; a transform would be a no-op on inline text)

P4.change: P1 + P3 together (static fonts + the .4/.3 px offset); P2 dropped, EXECUTION section 7

P5.change: Slate text model: the input is text_off_{A,B}.png (every glyph transparent via -webkit-text-fill-color, icons and boxes kept); T2's make_p5.py re-draws the 36 text runs with FreeType (freetype-py) at the chosen Slate hinting and writes controls/{A,B}/P5.png. T0 renders no P5.png: ref_check checks the input and leaves P5.png out of the frozen set

P6.change: vector AA model (EXECUTION section 7, T2 ruling R4): the unmodified board rendered by the same Chromium, page, fonts and 3000 ms freeze at deviceScaleFactor 4 (ref_render.py --only p6: raw/p6_A_4x.png, and the matte pair raw/p6_black_4x.png + raw/p6_white_4x.png composited over the 1x world_layer.png for pair B), box-filtered to 1920x1080 by make_p6.py; its vector-class pixels (regions.json class map) replace the base's, every other pixel is the base. T0 renders only the 4x inputs: ref_check checks them and leaves P6.png out of the frozen set

N5.change: eye-button border removed (border-color transparent, so the layout does not move)

N6.change: Stop icon replaced by the grid icon (command card slot S)

N7.change: stat line JetBrains Mono -> Inter (row and run, line-height pinned at 15.6 px)
